How to get it :
- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] : 6 x cast plate (Steel), 64 x Concrete Tile, 16 x ingot (plastic), 24 x [[gv:steel_scaffold|Steel Scaffold]], 2 x [[gv:circuit_advanced|Military Grade Circuit Board]] - [[gv:schemas|blueprint required]]: Heavy warheads.

Power: plug in from the sides (the top is closed, as in NTM).
